Type: table
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Reclaimed Wood Ladder-Rung Counter-Height Dining Table Bar, 36"H x 44"L, Fir
Colors: Brown
Materials: stone
Reclaimed fir wood and ladder-rung pedestals give this counter-height table simple rustic beauty. Warm natural wood tones make your space inviting, while sturdy construction will make this piece last for decades. 44"W x 20"D x 36"H Made of hardwood; comprised of 100% reclaimed fir A simple, natural style that will work with modern farmhouse décor Multi-functional as a dining table, bar, desk, or extra counter space No assembly required Free returns for 30 days. 3-year warranty.
